notes.title: Pendula Swing: The Complete Journey Patch 3.1.3 - your stories, published!
notes.notes:
You wrote it, we published it! 

The literary artworks submitted by you, awesome adventurers, have now been published in Pendula Swing: The Complete Journey! Take a stroll in the Academic District and spend some relaxing time in the library. If you have any favorite story, let us know!

With this update, we also took the occasion to fix a few bugs reported by you - thank you So Much for your reports and help! Specifically, we looked into the conversation with Jeff Wings, whee some of you got stuck.  He will no longer refuse to talk to you if you start by inquiring about his brother. We also made sure that you cannot get stuck in the Immigration Checkpoint.

notes.title: Today's 42 is 3.1.1 - a patch with tiny fixes, thanks to your useful reports!
notes.notes:
Greetings, adventurers!

First and foremost, Thank You for being by our side this weekend, when our work for the past two years culminated in the launch of Pendula Swing: The Complete Journey! While it feels like we have done a much better job with bug squashing*, some of you still found some tiny issues that we fixed. The patch is 3.1.1. Here's what we fixed:


 some of you experienced crashes in the Harbour District - this was likely due to the Police being overly active with prohibition, probably because we stole their Chief's painting so many times; this should now be fixed 
 Jeff Wings occasionally lost himself in conversation, which prevented some of you to complete the main story line - he will pay more attention to you now, thus allowing you to move on
 Giglesh'Kern seems to be the sweetheart of Duberdon when it comes to dates, so we had a chat with him and taught him how to better shoot you gazes of love and ... well, he also decided to react if you still wear clothes when you're both in your bedroom. Right - This Is Also A Spoiler Alert 
 the invitation to your cousin's wake now also serves as an invitation to the city, so make sure you grab it when you leave home
 several characters have been... called to the principal's office and we taught them how to behave a little better
 we also fixed some typos, like the speakeasy' bartender's super sexy line "this is a test text"


We continue to keep an eye on your feedback! We are currently working in the Library to publish all the awesome content you sent to us, so we will be patching soon again!

*as always, no real bugs were squashed during the development of this game
